commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Portu (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
89' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Robert Navarro and he is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
86' It is time for a substitution. Toni Villa is on for Artem Dovbyk (Girona).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Girona) will replace Yan Couto.
82' 4 - 1 Portu (Girona) receives the ball after one of the defenders fails to make a clearance and sends the ball into the back of the net!
81' 3 - 1 The ball from the corner slips through the box to Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) and he fires it into the bottom left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
81' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cadiz CF.
80' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Paulo Gazzaniga.
76' Michel decides to make a substitution. Miguel Gutierrez will be replaced by Arnau Martinez (Girona).
76' Today's match ends for Ivan Martin who will be replaced by Portu (Girona).
75' Victor Chust (Cadiz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Referee Javier Alberola Rojas signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Girona players have a reason to celebrate!
72' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Girona players aren’t happy.
72' The attendance is 12665.
71' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Miguel Gutierrez tees up Artem Dovbyk (Girona) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Conan Ledesma.
70' Here is a change. Maximiliano Gomez is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Roger Marti (Cadiz).
70' Substitution. Ivan Alejo is replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
69' It seemed like Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
68' Lucas Pires latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) and heads towards goal.
63' Aiham Ousou (Cadiz) sends an accurate short pass. Victor Chust controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
62' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle after Robert Navarro (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
58' Substitution. Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) in, Yangel Herrera out.

56' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
56' Cadiz CF get a corner.

53' A cross by Yan Couto (Girona) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
51' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
50' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Robert Navarro. The ball is out of play. Girona will take a throw-in.
46' Half-time substitution. Alex Fernandez will not participate anymore and Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Mauricio Pellegrino gives a chance to Chris Ramos (Cadiz) and Juanmi is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Crossbar! Savio (Girona) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ivan Martin (Girona) heads on.
43' Cadiz CF are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) was quite harsh and Javier Alberola Rojas didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
36' Yangel Herrera (Girona) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
35' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
32' Savio (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
31' Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
30' 3:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
28' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
25' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
22' 2 - 0 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez shows great vision to find Ivan Martin (Girona) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
18' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) trips an opposition player and Javier Alberola Rojas signals a foul.
16' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Cadiz CF out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
14' The Girona players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Artem Dovbyk (Girona) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
9' 1 - 0 Savio produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Eric Garcia (Girona) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
9' Savio (Girona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
6' The resulting corner from Eric Garcia (Girona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
4' Savio (Girona) and Ivan Martin matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola Rojas.
